## Checklist

- [ ] Same seed still gives the same trace, or the change is listed as a simulation behaviour change in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Public API changes dumped with `./gradlew apiDump` and explained
- [ ] Failure output or report changes: before/after pasted below
- [ ] docs/CAPABILITIES.md updated if what SyncLab can or cannot find changed
